summary: Iteration 225 - Batch 12 (TodayHub + Command Palette) + Batch 13 (TR Compliance KBS + e-Fatura) tested. Backend: 20/20 tests passed. Frontend: All features working. TodayHub shows Turkish greeting with 8 KPI tiles, 3 action cards, 3 info cards. Command Palette trigger visible, dialog opens, search works ('walk' → 'Walk-in Express'), Ctrl+K shortcut works. TR Compliance Panel has 2 tabs (KBS · Kimlik Bildirim, e-Arşiv / e-Fatura), KBS export creates TXT with history tracking, e-Fatura builds UBL-TR 2.1 XML with correct ProfileID (EARSIVFATURA/TICARIFATURA). Smoke regression passed for Tier-1 Dashboard and Morning Brief.
